steps.eval: (() => { const section = document.querySelector('#settings-credentials'); if (!section) throw new Error('设置页缺少凭据安全分节'); section.scrollIntoView({ block: 'center' }); const grid = section.querySelector('.rp-cred-matrix-grid'); if (!grid) throw new Error('凭据策略矩阵缺失（应为多列卡片栅格）'); if (section.querySelector('table')) throw new Error('凭据策略不应再是表格'); const cards = [...grid.children]; if (cards.length < 3) throw new Error('策略卡片数量不足: ' + cards.length); const rects = cards.map((el) => el.getBoundingClientRect()); if (rects.some((r) => r.width < 120 || r.height < 40)) throw new Error('策略卡片尺寸异常'); return { section: true, cards: cards.length, columns: new Set(rects.map((r) => Math.round(r.x))).size }; })()

(() => { const dialog = [...document.querySelectorAll('[role="dialog"]')].find((el) => (el.innerText || '').includes('凭据库') && (el.innerText || '').includes('新建凭据')); if (!dialog) throw new Error('凭据库管理弹窗未打开'); return { open: true, title: (dialog.querySelector('h2')?.innerText || '').trim() }; })()

(async () => { const dialog = [...document.querySelectorAll('[role="dialog"]')].find((el) => (el.innerText || '').includes('新建凭据') && el.querySelectorAll('input').length >= 4); if (!dialog) throw new Error('新建凭据表单未展开'); const inputs = [...dialog.querySelectorAll('input')]; const form = inputs.filter((el) => el.placeholder !== '搜索名称 / 用户名 / 域 / 备注'); if (form.length < 4) throw new Error('凭据表单字段不足: ' + form.length); const setter = Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(HTMLInputElement.prototype, 'value').set; const set = (el, value) => { setter.call(el, value); el.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', { bubbles: true })); }; set(form[0], 'UI-CRED-01'); set(form[1], 'svc-ui'); set(form[2], 'CORP'); set(form[3], 'P@ss-UI-123'); await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 150)); return { fields: form.length, name: form[0].value }; })()

(async () => { const res = await window.api.credentials.library(); if (!res.ok) throw new Error('凭据库列表失败: ' + res.error.message); const item = res.data.find((entry) => entry.name === 'UI-CRED-01'); if (!item) throw new Error('新建凭据未出现在列表中: ' + res.data.map((entry) => entry.name).join(',')); if (!item.hasPassword) throw new Error('凭据未标记为已保存密码'); const health = await window.api.credentials.health(); if (!health.ok) throw new Error('凭据健康检查失败'); return { created: true, id: item.id, total: res.data.length, healthTotal: health.data.total }; })()
(() => { const dialogs = [...document.querySelectorAll('[role="dialog"]')]; if (dialogs.length !== 0) throw new Error('Esc 后凭据弹窗仍在: ' + dialogs.length); return { closed: true }; })()
